title: 23 October 1963: Recording, mixing: I Wanna Be Your Man, Little Child, Hold Me Tight
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Norman Smith

The final recording session for With The Beatles saw a final overdub onto ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’ and three mono mixes.

The overdub was a tambourine part (player unknown), recorded onto take 15 as take 16.

‘I Wanna Be Your Man’ was the first of the two songs to be mixed, followed by ‘Little Child’ and ‘Hold Me Tight’. The session began at 10am and finished at 1pm, after which The Beatles flew to Sweden for their first foreign tour.
